images.title: Chang'e-3 lunar landing site
images.description: Annotated image of the approximate landing site of the Chinese Chang'e-3 lander. It was launched at 17:30 UTC on 1 December 2013, and reached the Moon's surface on 14 December 2013. The lunar coordinates are: 44.12°N 19.51°W. [ 1 ]
